title: Con il muso all’insù
hero_alt: The Frecce Tricolori trailing green, white and red smoke
cover_alt: A yellow-winged T-6 Texan passing under a daytime moon
lede: Nose up, literally: a small airfield on the edge of Turin with the Alps behind it, and the day Pratica di Mare celebrated a hundred years of the Italian Air Force.
meta_description: Aircraft at the Aeritalia airfield in Turin, under the Alps, and at the Italian Air Force centenary air show at Pratica di Mare in 2023.

1.title: Aeritalia
1.intro: A grass and asphalt airfield on the western edge of Turin, where the plain stops and the Alps begin. Light aircraft, helicopters and, one day in May, vintage warbirds and aerobatics.

2.title: Pratica di Mare
2.intro: The Italian Air Force was founded in 1923, and for its hundredth birthday it filled the sky over its base south of Rome: historic aircraft, today's fighters, tankers and transports, and the Frecce Tricolori to finish.
